decision: WF-105 design: how the researched 30-minute series poll runs, and where the WF-105 domain module lives given WF-111 already owns backend/dsr/automation_engagement/

state.research: Series is polled every 30 minutes to evaluate entry and progression. Re-entry is data-driven. The exit rule is sticky. A tag block writes an existing workspace tag; it cannot create one.

poll_options.on_demand: POST /api/wf105/series/{id}/poll runs one poll over caller-supplied recurring events and records what it decided. The 30-minute cadence is served as vocabulary; the series records last_polled_at.
poll_options.background_job: A feature-owned thread inside the process calls the poll every 30 minutes.

package_options.subpackage: Add backend/dsr/automation_engagement/series/ and edit no WF-111 file.
package_options.shared_package_edit: Add modules directly beside WF-111's errors.py, rules.py and vocabulary.py.
package_options.new_top_level: Create an unrelated top-level package and ignore the brief's named path.

constraints: A single-writer audited store; a second writer beside it is a correctness risk.
A feature adds files and edits no other workflow's files.
The brief names backend/dsr/automation_engagement/ as the domain path.
Tests must not sleep or depend on a wall clock.

state.revision: The cadence is now owned by the domain and served, not only documented. Each series records last_polled_at and poll_interval_minutes. GET /api/wf105/due lists live series whose next poll is due. GET /api/wf105/series/{id}/due reports due plus next_due_at. POST /api/wf105/series/{id}/poll runs one synchronous poll and records last_polled_at. rules.due_for_poll is the pure rule both routes use.

poll_options.due_surface_on_demand: The poll is a synchronous call. The domain owns the cadence and serves which series are due, so a platform scheduler drives the researched 30-minute interval with no timer in the feature.
poll_options.in_process_timer: A thread inside the feature calls the poll every 30 minutes.
poll_options.poll_without_due_surface: An on-demand poll that documents the cadence but cannot report when a series is next due.

constraints: Single-writer audited store: a second in-process writer is a correctness risk.
The feature contract forbids editing shared files and other workflows' files.
Tests must not sleep or depend on a wall clock; a frozen clock drives the cadence tests.
The brief names backend/dsr/automation_engagement/ as the domain path; WF-111 already owns its files.
